notes: All downloads use a fixed Hugging Face revision (a commit SHA).
fetch_models.py verifies sha256 when the value is not null. Small non-LFS files have no sha256 in the Hugging Face API.

pl_PL-zenski_wg_glos-medium.deviation: Not in the official rhasspy/piper-voices catalog. Source is the original community repo WitoldG/polish_piper_models. A sherpa-onnx repackage also exists: csukuangfj/vits-piper-pl_PL-zenski_wg_glos-medium.
